players.bio: Adam Uche Idah is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Swansea City and the Republic of Ireland national team. Idah made his first senior appearance on 27 August 2019, playing the full 90 minutes as Norwich lost 1–0 at Crawley Town in the EFL Cup.
Andrew Lee Fisher (born 12 February 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Swansea City.
Benjamin Cabango (born 30 May 2000) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a defender for Swansea City.

Ben Lloyd is a 21-year-old Welsh professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Swansea City. A lifelong Swansea fan, he progressed through the club's youth academy before signing his first professional contract in 2022. He is a Wales under-21 international.
Cameron Robert Burgess (born 21 October 1995) is an Australian professional footballer who plays as a central or left defender for Swansea City .
Elijah Henry Just is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for EFL Championship club Swansea City and the New Zealand national team.
Filip Lissah is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Swansea City. He is a product of the Chelsea and Swansea City youth academies.
Gonçalo Batista Franco (born 17 November 2000) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Swansea City.

Jay Fulton (born 4 April 1994) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Swansea City. Fulton aged 17 made his first team debut on 12 April 2011 as a substitute in Falkirk's 2–0 win over Partick Thistle in the Scottish First Division. He made one further appearance that season.
Jenson Seelt is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Swansea City, on loan from Premier League club Sunderland.
Jeremy Ngola Monga is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Swansea City, on loan from Premier League club Manchester City.
Eom Ji-sung (Korean: 엄지성; born 9 May 2002) is a South Korean footballer currently playing as a winger for EFL Championship club Swansea City and the South Korea national team.

Joseph Amankwaah Opoku is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for the Belgian club SV Zulte Waregem. Born on August 8, 2005, he is considered one of Ghana's brightest young prospects. Opoku joined SV Zulte Waregem in August 2024 from the Accra-based club Great Corinthians.

Joshua Lewis Tymon (born 22 May 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Swansea City. Tymon began his career with his local club Hull City before joining Stoke City in July 2017 following the Tigers' relegation in 2016–17. He spent time on loan at Milton Keynes Dons in 2017–18.
Joshua Myles Abraham Key is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Swansea City.

Lawrence Ian Vigouroux (born 19 November 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Swansea City. Born in England, Vigouroux has represented Chile as a youth international level. Born in Camden, England, Vigouroux started his football education within the youth set-up at Brentford.

Marko Seufatu Nikola Stamenić is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Swansea City and the New Zealand national team. Born in Wellington and raised in Stokes Valley, Stamenić graduated from the Olé Football Academy and signed for FC Copenhagen in September 2020 following extended trials.
Viktor Melker Widell (born 19 April 2002) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays either in central midfield or as a winger for EFL Championship club Swansea City.

Moussa Yeo is a 22-year-old Malian professional footballer who plays as a versatile winger or attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Swansea City. Born on 1 June 2004 in Bamako, Mali, he recently completed a high-profile permanent transfer to the Welsh club from Austrian giants FC Red Bull Salzburg.

Paul David Appleby Farman (born 2 November 1989) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Swansea City. Farman started his career as a youngster with Newcastle United and joined Blyth Spartans following a month long spell at Washington before signing for Gateshead in the summer of 2009.

Ronald Pereira Martins (born 14 June 2001), simply known as Ronald, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Swansea City. Club career Born in Corumbá, Mato Grosso do Sul, Ronald began his career with hometown side Corumbaense.

Ross Cameron Stewart (born 11 July 1996) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Swansea City and the Scotland national team. Stewart is a graduate from the Motherwell youth system, and was in direct competition with regular number 2 Lee Hollis for a place on the bench during the 2012–13 season.

Stephen Welsh is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Swansea City. Welsh began his career in the youth sides at Celtic, stepping up to their development side in 2017, and in March 2018, signed a contract with the club until 2020. Alongside fixtures in the SPFL Development League, he featured for the team in the Scottish Challenge Cup.
Thomas Achi Iorpenda (born 6 April 2005) is an English footballer who plays as a midfielder for Notts County on loan from EFL League One club Huddersfield Town.

Vítor Emanuel Soares Matos (born 28 March 1988) is a Portuguese football manager who is the head coach of EFL Championship club Swansea City. Matos began his career coaching youth teams in Portugal, including at Porto. After two years coaching at Shandong Luneng in China, he returned to Porto before joining Premier League club Liverpool as an elite development coach under Jürgen Klopp in 2019.
Žan Vipotnik (born 18 March 2002) is a Slovenian professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Swansea City and the Slovenia national team.
